summary: Median barrier on a clearway arterial at the freeway ramp; nowhere to stop.

drivers.seclusion: Bush on the north bank beyond the carriageway, but the line itself sits in the median of a busy arterial.
drivers.access_and_room: Median barrier between carriageways; the north kerb has a continuous traffic lane and no pull-off.
drivers.convention: Clearway sign nearby; no cars parked along the kerb.

sun_shade: Open to sun; bush on the north bank shades the morning edge.
